issue.title: Merge copy: '1 notes moved', label merges print no merge rows or offer text, Pull-In title counts unlinked sources
issue.description:
Found while researching a capture `<` merge-into-new-task syntax (research:202611/capture_merge_into_new_task__cld.md §1.4, G2/G4/G5). These three merge-copy defects sit outside epic bob-cli-h4's scope. h4 deliberately kept `message` strings byte-identical and only serialized `merge_offers` for label merges. The tombstone diff pairing (G6) is recorded separately as a DISCOVERED ISSUE note on bob-cli-h4.

Suggested fix:
- **G4:** singularise `1 note moved` in `task_merge::plan`, and update the docs/task-merge.md §10 copy row and any byte-pinned tests.
- **G2:** route label-merge records through the same human merge renderer that `>` uses (header, source rows, consequences, offer rows), keeping the relation lines.
- **G5:** count only records that pruned a link (`links_pruned > 0`) when choosing between the one-source and N-source Pull-In titles.

Confirm the G5 wording with Bryan before changing it.

task_type_fields.impact: CLI users see ungrammatical merge rows (G4). A `~~ | merged into` capture gives no indication in the terminal of what it merged, cancelled, re-pointed, or what `-p 1` would link (G2), so the offer cannot be picked knowingly. The Pull-In title overstates which tasks T replaces (G5). The Mac is unaffected by G4 (it formats its own count) but shows G5's title verbatim. Low severity, but visible on every multi-source merge.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/task_merge/plan.rs:656; src/native/capture/pull_in_copy.rs:611-618; capture human output for relation merges (src/native/capture/output.rs)
task_type_fields.repro:
Scratch vault (never Bryan's vault). Use bob 0.4.0 built 2026-11-05 10:37; bob-cli master 58e98558 has no task_merge, pull_in_copy, or capture output changes since that build. The vault has `relations: {merge_labels: [merged into]}` and these notes:
- foo.md: `- [*] #task Fix the flaky login test ^f` (one child note, one nested child), linked under `- [ ] (1000-1025) — BUILD` in the daily note.
- bar.md: `- [ ] #task Login test timeout is too short ^b` (one child note).

1. **G4: plural.** Run `bob capture --dry-run -- $'Some great new task! @foo^great\n\n@foo+f @bar+b > @foo+great'`. It prints `⊘ Fix the flaky login test  foo.md:1 · Next → Cancelled · 1 notes moved`. The source is `src/native/task_merge/plan.rs:656`, `format!("{moved_notes} notes moved")`, which never singularises. The same string reaches `merges[].message`.
2. **G2: label merge human output.** Run `bob capture --dry-run -- 'Consolidate login test flakiness ~~bar:b|"merged into" ~~foo:f|"merged into"'`. It prints only `🪢 "…" would now link here · merged into   bar.md ^b` (one line per source), then a bare `-p 1 · -p all`. There is no `⤵ would merge …` header, no `⊘ … Next → Cancelled` source rows, no dependent rows, and no `◌ BUILD link removed · offer 1: …` row. The JSON *does* carry `merges[]` and `merge_offers`. The `>` path prints all of these rows for the identical merge.
3. **G5: Pull-In title count.** For the draft in step 1 (two merges, only `^f` was linked today), `pull_in.copy.title` is `Link “Some great new task!” in place of 2 merged tasks`. Only one source left a slot, so it should read `in place of “Fix the flaky login test”`. The source is `src/native/capture/pull_in_copy.rs:611–618`, which counts every `Merged` record. Note: h4 plan §E words the rule as one vs. more than one *merged source*, so this is a copy refinement to agree with Bryan, not a regression.

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching the capture '<' syntax: CLI merge output is ungrammatical, and ~~|merged into captures print no merge or offer rows. Both are outside the transfer-previews epic, which kept messages byte-identical.

payload.description: h4 shipped the merge card, merge_offers for label merges, and the Pull-In merge title, and kept message strings byte-identical; these copy fixes touch its outputs and byte-pinned tests.
